about: Host context interruption acceptance mutants. Run the named CLI killer; it builds emitted programs because the contract is a live foreign wait and completed cleanup.

mutants.name: e5-fatal
mutants.rule: A defect keeps status 2 and stops later packages, rather than becoming an ordinary failed law.

mutants.name: e5-empty
mutants.rule: An empty recursive selection is an error, never a green run with nothing tested.

mutants.name: e5-pattern
mutants.rule: check and test accept a recursive package pattern.

mutants.name: e5-roots
mutants.rule: Every selected package, not just the first root, runs.

mutants.name: e5-order
mutants.rule: Dependencies run before their dependents, independent of folder name order.

mutants.name: e5-status
mutants.rule: One failed law makes the module command exit 1.

mutants.name: e5-continue
mutants.rule: A failed law does not hide the tests of later packages.

mutants.name: e5-nested
mutants.rule: A nested module is outside the selected module.

mutants.name: e5-fmt
mutants.rule: fmt accepts the same recursive module pattern without checking types.

mutants.name: b15-r8-test-inherits-collector-policy
mutants.origin: wf10 batch-15 fix-r8, verifier r7 on-base
mutants.to:
child := exec.Command(binary, childArgs...)
	child.Stdout, child.Stderr, child.Stdin = os.Stdout, os.Stderr, os.Stdin
mutants.rule: A test program's Go collector works within the program's hard data cap, not its builder's larger limit.

mutants.name: b15-r8-test-inherits-gogc
mutants.rule: Bounded test programs do not inherit a disabled or enlarged GC target.

mutants.name: b15-r8-test-inherits-soft-limit
mutants.rule: The child's soft heap limit is below its hard data cap.

mutants.name: b15-r8-test-overrides-explicit-off
mutants.rule: An explicitly unbounded test program retains the caller's collector settings.

mutants.name: b15-r7-go-context-mask-ignored
mutants.rule: A completed release observes a masked, non-cancellable Go context.

mutants.name: b16a-receipt-omits-searched-law
mutants.origin: wf10 batch-16a integration (L10 receipts x X1 machine laws)
mutants.from: b.WriteString("\t\t" + l.helper("RecordSearch") + "(" + strconv.Quote(label) + ", " + held + ", " + how + ", " + where + ")\n\t}\n")
mutants.rule: runtime.md Tests 8: the law receipt has one entry per law run, a machine's searched reachability law included.

mutants.name: c3-api-route-removed
mutants.rule: The public inspect api command reaches its checked projection.

mutants.name: r3b-spell
mutants.rule: ergo gen rpc names the contract by its resolved import path, never by how the command spelled the folder; --check from any spelling finds current files current.

mutants.name: dist1-platform-unchecked
mutants.rule: A platform outside the target list is the EF110 refusal, however it was named.

mutants.name: dist1-platform-flag-on-run
mutants.rule: --platform belongs to build: run and test execute what they link, so they link for the host's platform.

mutants.name: dist1-environment-ignored
mutants.rule: Without --platform, GOOS and GOARCH of the environment choose the platform, as for go build.

mutants.name: dist1-action-ignores-platform
mutants.rule: The Go action links for the platform the options name.

mutants.name: dist1-cgo-left-to-the-host
mutants.rule: Every Ergo link is cgo-free: the bindings are typed with CGO_ENABLED=0, and a cross link has no C toolchain.

mutants.name: dist1-runtime-kqueue-arm64-only
mutants.rule: The runtime links on every platform of the target list (a build-tagged runtime file must cover each).

mutants.name: dist1-emission-keyed-on-platform
mutants.rule: The emitted module is platform-independent: one module serves every platform's link.
